title: WarpToad executable development fixture continuation

prior_evidence.preservation_rule: D1P-12 tracked and raw evidence is read-only and must remain byte-identical.

evidence_class: development artifact and behavior validation only

retrieval.scope: the pinned source revision, its lockfile-selected dependencies, and its supported toolchain
retrieval.origin_rule: Use ordinary approved network access. Do not use an alternate origin or bypass a denied origin. Record exact URL, origin and error for any failure.

setup_gate: observe exact Git revision or archive revision identity
match all five D1P-11 source hashes
hash and inspect hashing and constants crates before builds
inspect root/backend manifests, lockfile, compiler route, proving route and verifier generation settings
inventory historical compiled artifacts and generated verifiers separately from new local output
confirm sufficient free disk and no unsafe memory condition

proof_generation.second_attempt_rule: Record a concrete corrigible cause from attempt one. Keep circuit, witness policy, proof mode and parameters unchanged.

fixture.network: owned ephemeral local Hardhat network only
fixture.relayer: ordinary named local account; address(1) wildcard forbidden
fixture.fee_preference: Use a nonzero fee factor and record priority fee, maximum fee, base fee and computed fee. If only zero fee succeeds, label that limitation.
fixture.consumer: unchanged pinned WarpToadCore.mint with matching generated verifier
fixture.repeat_check: Reuse the identical accepted proof and calldata; require repeated-nullifier rejection and retain revert evidence.

canonicality.prerequisite: real generated verifier and one honest accepted proof/public vector
tests: for each of 11 public-input positions, replace the honest word with field modulus
for each of 11 public-input positions, replace the honest word with field modulus plus one
record return false, revert selector/data, or acceptance separately for every call
canonicality.interpretation: Report rejection, reduction or acceptance as verifier boundary behavior and a modeling obligation, not a vulnerability verdict.

completion: One coherent accepted proof-to-mint chain with effects, same-proof replay rejection and verifier canonicality results, or one exact reproducible blocker.
